title: Triage UPS outage and service-down incidents, write processed rows to Supabase memory, and preserve audit logs
task_prompt: You are operating in Northstar Infrastructure Response. Traverse the server fault incident pool, filter UPS outage and service-down risk work orders, execute the remediation logic for the actionable incidents, then write the processed handling records into the simulated Supabase in-memory database. Preserve a complete audit trail of the actions taken. Avoid processing unrelated categories such as network degradation or watchlist-only database lag tickets.
